results.title: 10. Routine furnace (naturalness)
transcript: AGENT : Thanks for calling Summit Air. This is the automated assistant. How can I help?
CALLER: Hi. My furnace stopped working.
AGENT : Got it. Is there anyone in the home who would be at risk without heat, like an older person, a baby, or someone with a health issue?
CALLER: No, it's just me, a healthy adult.
AGENT : Okay, and what is the address where the furnace is?
CALLER: 48 Bergen Street, Brooklyn, 11201.
tool  check_address({"street": "48 Bergen Street", "town": "Brooklyn", "zip_code": "11201"})
->    In the service area. Read it back once as 48 Bergen Street, Brooklyn, ZIP 11201, and wait for a yes.
AGENT : That's 48 Bergen Street, Brooklyn, ZIP 11201, right?
CALLER: Yes, that's right.
tool  check_availability({"earliest_date": "2026-09-29", "part_of_day": "any"})
->    Open windows: Wednesday, September 30, between 8 AM and noon (slot_id 2026-09-30-0800); Wednesday, September 30, between noon and 4 PM (slot_id 2026-09-30-1200)
AGENT : I have openings Wednesday, September 30, morning or afternoon. Which works better for you?
CALLER: Morning works better for me, please.

tool  book_appointment({"slot_id": "2026-09-30-0800", "customer_type": "residential", "name": "", "callback_number": "+19145550100", "address": "48 Bergen Street, Brooklyn", "zip_code": "11201", "issue": "furnace stopped working", "priority": false, "note": null, "business_name": null, "site_contact": null})
->    No name yet. Ask the caller for their name, then book. Don't use a placeholder.
AGENT : What's your name, please?
CALLER: David Shatsky.

tool  book_appointment({"slot_id": "2026-09-30-0800", "customer_type": "residential", "name": "David Shatsky", "callback_number": "+19145550100", "address": "48 Bergen Street, Brooklyn", "zip_code": "11201", "issue": "furnace stopped working", "priority": false, "note": null, "business_name": null, "site_contact": null})
->    Booked. Reference 1001: Wednesday, September 30, between 8 AM and noon at 48 Bergen Street, Brooklyn. Tell the caller the day, window, address and reference number.
AGENT : You're booked for Wednesday, September 30, between 8 AM and noon at 48 Bergen Street, Brooklyn. Your reference number is 1001. Is there anything else I can help with?
CALLER: No, that's all. Thank you!
tool  end_call({})
AGENT : Thanks for calling Summit Air. Goodbye.

results.title: 3. The new gas wording
transcript: AGENT : Thanks for calling Summit Air. This is the automated assistant. How can I help?
CALLER: Hi, I think gas is leaking from my stove.

AGENT : Just to be safe: if you smell gas, see smoke, or have a carbon monoxide alarm going off right now, please leave the house with everyone, don't touch any light switches or appliances, and call 911 from outside. Is that what's happening?
CALLER: Yes.

tool  create_dispatch_task({"kind": "emergency", "reason": "gas leak from stove", "summary": "gas leak, caller instructed to leave the house and call 911", "name": null, "callback_number": null, "address": null})
->    Emergency task 2001 already exists and on-call has it. The callback target is 12:50 PM. Tell the caller the target, and never promise an arrival time.
AGENT : Please leave the house and call 911 from outside. Our on-call team already knows and will call you back by 12:50 PM. Is there anything else I can do for you?

tasks.reason: possible gas, carbon monoxide or smoke
tasks.summary: Hi, I think gas is leaking from my stove.
